testcase_source.revision_policy: A change to journey, receipt, runner, app source, effective lock, override, fixture contract or pinned goal requires a new candidate revision and fresh independent reviews.

build.verification: Record exact build command/toolchain and verify package, debug variant, version, ABI and APK digest before install. The digest is per-run evidence; source/lock/override/runner/testcase pins keep this testcase revision valid.

model.open_point: No provider call until both independent reviews approve this exact candidate and the Android device squad records AVD admission.

execution.command_template: ARTEMIS_ARTEMIS_JSONC=qualification/configs/che6852_st008_openai.artemis.jsonc artemis run '<exact goal text>' --standalone --profile pro --assertion-exit --device-serial <leased serial> --locked-app com.palio.ai --disable-planner-validation --verification-level strict --session-id <fresh UUIDv4> --run-id <fresh UUIDv4> --traces-path <run evidence dir>/traces
execution.locked_app_permission_dialogs: No. Static source review of artemis/runtime/device_policy.py shows check_foreground requires the resumed package to equal com.palio.ai and latches LeftTestApp otherwise. The Android permission-controller dialog has a different resumed package, so goal_02's OS prompt scenarios must remain NOT-RUN. This behavior has not been runtime tested.

firebase_debugview.prerequisite: Independent authorized Firebase DebugView fixture and access, recorded by the Android device squad leader.

store_sandbox_purchase.prerequisite: Independent store-sandbox fixture and access, recorded by the Android device squad leader. No purchase is fabricated and no money is spent.

fixture.onboarding: NOT-RUN until the leader records a clean first-run fixture and the authorized executor verifies it. Synthetic name Artemis QA; do not retain entered values or use personal data.
fixture.permission: NOT-RUN for event_12 through event_16: locked-app foreground enforcement rejects the permission-controller package. Do not infer displayed prompt from focus loss or a pending native call.

speaking.reason: No admitted deterministic speaking session/backend fixture is pinned; this includes event_20 through event_23.

flash_cards.reason: No deterministic nonempty, empty or load-failure deck fixture is pinned; this includes event_24 through event_27.

ads.reason: No controlled display-callback fixture or verified transitive SDK emission fixture is pinned; this includes event_17, event_18 and event_19.

paywall.reason: No verified real weekly/yearly store offers or authorized sandbox fixture is pinned; this includes event_28 through event_32. Never fabricate product IDs or purchase.

login.account: No authorized nonpersonal Google test account is available; do not sign in. Home after login redirect and authentication-family removal checks remain NOT-RUN (event_11, removal_06).

reset.app_data: adb -s <leased serial> shell pm clear com.palio.ai
permissions: adb -s <leased serial> shell pm revoke com.palio.ai android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
adb -s <leased serial> shell pm revoke com.palio.ai android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO
adb -s <leased serial> shell pm clear-permission-flags com.palio.ai android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS user-set user-fixed
adb -s <leased serial> shell pm clear-permission-flags com.palio.ai android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO user-set user-fixed
reset.scope: Run only after admission, both reviews and lease. Target the leased serial. Never reset shared device state.

setup: adb -s <leased serial> shell setprop debug.firebase.analytics.app com.palio.ai
adb -s <leased serial> shell setprop log.tag.FA VERBOSE
adb -s <leased serial> shell setprop log.tag.FA-SVC VERBOSE
adb -s <leased serial> logcat -v threadtime -s FA FA-SVC
fa_debug.restore: Before setup, capture getprop debug.firebase.analytics.app, getprop log.tag.FA, and getprop log.tag.FA-SVC. Restore each property to its exact captured value; do not assume .none. Disable the capture process after the observation window.

fixture.synchronization: Visible UI plus timestamped FA/FA-SVC capture. Event assertion requires exact event, allowed parameters, count and ordering in the complete observation window.

capture: device class, API, ABI and assigned serial
runner, testcase, app source, lock and override revisions
fresh fixture/reset and visible entry state
timestamped redacted FA and FA-SVC logs
per-event and per-removal result with exact count and parameters
first-run, clean-rerun and negative-control result when class qualification applies
evidence_contract.privacy: Never retain names, account identifiers, tokens, transcripts, audio, lesson/session IDs, URLs, purchase identifiers or credential values. Keep raw logs private; retain minimum redacted evidence.

exit_codes.0: All required native assertions complete and pass.
exit_codes.1: Completed native assertion failure, including the deliberate qualification control.
exit_codes.2: Incomplete, malformed, unchecked or inconclusive evidence; never PASS.

evidence_contract.unobserved_count: unknown; never infer zero from missing evidence

qualification.positive_pass: Clean representative testcase pass with complete artifacts.
qualification.clean_rerun: Repeat from the clean reset contract; preserve independent result and artifacts.

negative_control.proof: complete native summary has exactly this failed item, the observed title is different, marker ARTEMIS_ASSERTION_EXIT=1 is present, and process exit is 1

qualification.cleanup_release: Preserve evidence, stop only run-owned processes, restore only changed settings, and obtain Android leader verification of device/lease release.
qualification.missing_or_uncertain_evidence: NOT-RUN or inconclusive; never qualify. Uncertain cleanup keeps target unavailable with named recovery owner.

goals.text: NOT-RUN until the Android leader records an approved clean first-run fixture: event_01 through event_09, removal_02, and removal_04 have unknown counts. With that fixture, observe and assert every listed visible onboarding step in order; enter only the synthetic name Artemis QA; verify the native locale on entry; stop at the login redirect without signing in; capture timestamped FA/FA-SVC logs and visible-state evidence. Assert event_01=splash_scr_view, event_02=obd_1_scr_view, event_03=obd_2_scr_view, event_04=obd_3_scr_view, event_05=lfo_1_scr_view, event_06=lfo_2_scr_view with language=<selected locale tag on entry: en|hi|pt-pt|es-mx|es-es|fr|vi>, event_07=obd_6_scr_view, event_08=obd_7_scr_view, event_09=obd_8_scr_view, event_10=obd_full_8_scr_view as DEFERRED only, event_11=home_scr_view as NOT-RUN without an authorized test login. Assert exactly one event for each visible trigger from event_01 through event_09, with only its row parameters and the observed step order. Assert removal_02=splash_bootstrap_started|splash_bootstrap_completed|splash_bootstrap_failed and removal_04=language_selected|onboarding_started|onboarding_next_tapped|onboarding_completed absent with count 0 in the complete captured onboarding window; otherwise mark NOT-RUN. Missing UI or incomplete capture is not PASS.

NOT-RUN: --locked-app com.palio.ai does not permit the Android permission-controller foreground package, so do not attempt notification or microphone OS dialogs. Keep event_12=noti_permission_view with source=app_entry|account, event_13=noti_permission_allow, event_14=microphone_permission_view with source=speaking, event_15=microphone_permission_allow, event_16=microphone_permission_denied and removal_05=permission_request_tapped|permission_result|account_notifications_enable_tapped|account_notification_permission_result explicitly NOT-RUN. Record no observed count for these rows. A future admitted run may assert these only after the runner lock policy changes and both reviewers approve that candidate. No focus loss or pending call is proof of a displayed dialog.

NOT-RUN until the speaking session and flash-card deck fixtures are pinned by the Android leader. Required assertion items are event_20=feature_speaking_scr_view, event_21=feature_speaking_start, event_22=feature_speaking_finish, event_23=feature_speaking_fail with error_code=microphone_denied|start_failed|connection_failed|invalid_token|timeout|unknown, event_24=feature_flash_card_scr_view, event_25=feature_flash_card_start, event_26=feature_flash_card_success, event_27=feature_flash_card_fail with error_code=load_failed|empty_deck|timeout|unknown, and removal_09=lesson_selected|lesson_start|lesson_end|lesson_complete. In a fixture-backed run, assert one start per accepted attempt, at most one real finish per ready result, one fail per terminal failed attempt, one feature view per session, one flash-card start per attempt, one success per nonempty deck completion, and one fail per terminal deck failure. Preserve native ledger and timestamped logs; no fixture means NOT-RUN, with count unknown and never zero.

NOT-RUN until verified ad callbacks, real store offers and authorized sandbox fixtures exist. Required assertion items are event_17=inter_splash_scr_view, event_18=inter_home_scr_view, event_19=app_open_scr_view with placement=open_resume, event_28=paywall_scr_view with source=home|speaking|direct and paywall_id=premium_weekly_trial, event_29=paywall_scr_view with source=home|speaking|direct and paywall_id=premium_yearly_exit, event_30=paywall_btn_click with button=purchase|restore|terms_of_use|privacy_policy|close, product_id=<real weekly product ID or none>, source=home|speaking|direct, event_31=paywall_btn_click with button=purchase|close, product_id=<real yearly product ID for purchase or none>, source=home|speaking|direct, event_32=in_app_purchase with automatic schema only, removal_10=interstitial_show|interstitial_failed, and removal_11=premium_purchase_attempt|premium_purchase_success|premium_purchase_cancelled|premium_purchase_failed|premium_restore_attempt|premium_restore_success|premium_restore_failed. If later fixture-backed, assert exactly one event per accepted impression or click trigger and inspect actual transitive SDK emissions. No fixture means NOT-RUN and count unknown. Never fabricate impressions or purchases, disable automatic collection, or spend money.

For each complete actual SDK emission window, assert zero occurrences for each exact removed family: removal_01=app_open|app_foreground|app_background; removal_02=splash_bootstrap_started|splash_bootstrap_completed|splash_bootstrap_failed; removal_03=navigation_route_changed|screen_view; removal_04=language_selected|onboarding_started|onboarding_next_tapped|onboarding_completed; removal_05=permission_request_tapped|permission_result|account_notifications_enable_tapped|account_notification_permission_result; removal_06=login_google_start|login_google_success|login_google_cancelled|login_google_failed|login_backend_failed|login_google_error|logout_tapped|logout_success; removal_07=home_tab_selected|practice_tab_selected|redeem_tab_selected|rank_tab_selected|account_tab_selected; removal_08=account_language_opened|account_language_changed|account_rate_app_tapped|account_contact_us_tapped|account_share_app_tapped; removal_09=lesson_selected|lesson_start|lesson_end|lesson_complete; removal_10=interstitial_show|interstitial_failed; removal_11=premium_purchase_attempt|premium_purchase_success|premium_purchase_cancelled|premium_purchase_failed|premium_restore_attempt|premium_restore_success|premium_restore_failed; removal_12=api_call_failed|api_call_timeout. Mark a family NOT-RUN when its flow fixture or complete SDK capture is unavailable; missing logs are not zero. Preserve automatic Firebase collection. If the device class is unqualified, use the qualification negative control assertion_id=negative_control_title with wrong value `Palios — WRONG TITLE`; require one failed native item, ARTEMIS_ASSERTION_EXIT=1 and process exit 1. Retain artifacts and obtain leader cleanup/release verification.

Run the approved clean onboarding fixture as a separate qualification attempt. Assert assertion_id=negative_control_title: the visible Palios app title is exactly `Palios — WRONG TITLE`. The native summary must contain exactly one failed item for this assertion, the observed title must differ from the wrong value, stdout must contain ARTEMIS_ASSERTION_EXIT=1, and the process exit must equal 1. Keep this expected failure separate from positive runs; exit 0, exit 2, a missing marker, incomplete evidence or another failed item invalidates the control.

logic_review_findings.requirement: Focus loss during a pending native permission request does not count as a displayed prompt; observe the actual OS dialog.
logic_review_findings.failure_behavior: Fail the assertion or mark NOT-RUN if dialog visibility cannot be proven.

logic_review_findings.requirement: Overlapping notification/microphone requests and native bridge errors preserve safe speaking failure behavior and do not create false prompt events.
logic_review_findings.failure_behavior: Fail on unsafe speaking continuation, duplicate prompt event or ambiguous request result.

logic_review_findings.requirement: Notification status unavailable creates no false telemetry and no extra prompt.
logic_review_findings.failure_behavior: Fail on notification custom event or any additional OS prompt.

logic_review_findings.requirement: Speaking and flash-card real-return counts match the contract, including recovery, cancellation, retries, empty deck and duplicate callback cases.
logic_review_findings.failure_behavior: Fail on any count mismatch or false success/finish.

logic_review_findings.requirement: Inspect actual transitive SDK emissions because Git-source/hosted parity is unverified.
logic_review_findings.failure_behavior: Source-only review or app adapter logs cannot pass SDK emission coverage.
